summary: Processes mouse-button inputs into HUD text labels when the hover timer at this+0x384 has reached the 0.667 threshold and the HUD flag byte_7CE254 is clear. Walks dword_7CB218 input-action entries from word_7CB21C, maps action codes 4098-4107 to button indices via the jpt_45F095 jump table, bounds-checks the index against the button count at this+0x1B78C, and traverses the button-state linked list headed at this+0x1B780. For the selected node it formats and clamps the label string (falling back to byte_5EA438 when empty), encodes a progress-bar event with ProgressBarEventEncode using dbl_8AFEA0, builds the text through sub_587DD0/sub_4B0B20/StringCopyWithFormatQuery/SessionStateDispatch, allocates a texture via TextureCreationWrapper, renders the wrapped line with TextLineWrappingAndRendering into dword_7CD204, then resets the hover timer.

local_names.this: UI/HUD handler object; this+0x384 is the hover timer, this+0x1B780 the button-state list head, this+0x1B78C the button count
local_names.v12: walking pointer over the action-code array word_7CB21C
local_names.v2: mapped button index derived from the action code switch
local_names.v3: position inside the button-state linked list being descended
local_names.v4: current list node pointer while traversing next pointers at node+4
local_names.v8: clamped label length used by formatting and progress-bar encode

operations.description: outer gate: the hover timer this[225] at byte 0x384 must be >= 0.667 and the HUD-disable flag byte_7CE254 (0x007CE254) must be clear before any mouse-label handling
iterate dword_7CB218 (0x007CB218) input-action entries, walking the action-code array at word_7CB21C (0x007CB21C)
the switch on the action code maps codes 4098..4107 to button indices 1..10 via the jump table jpt_45F095 (0x0045F278); unknown codes are skipped
bounds-check the mapped button index against the button count *((_DWORD*)this + 28131) at byte 0x1B78C, skipping out-of-range indices
traverse the button-state linked list headed at byte 0x1B780: follow the next pointer stored at node+4 and read the node data pointer stored at node+0
only handle a list node whose dereferenced data pointer (node->data, field at *(*(*(this+0x1B780)+0x4)+0x0)) is non-null
label fallback: when the node's label string pointer is null, use byte_5EA438 (0x005EA438)
clamp the label length v8 (from strlen of the label plus one) to the range 0..159 before formatting
ProgressBarEventEncode(4, 6, v8, 0, LODWORD(v11), 1) encodes a progress-bar label event whose duration comes from the double constant dbl_8AFEA0 (0x008AFEA0)

build and render the label: sub_587DD0(v21, v9, v8) copies the clamped text, sub_4B0B20(v14, 64) and StringCopyWithFormatQuery(v14, v21, v17, 128) format it, SessionStateDispatch(v17) forwards it, and TextLineWrappingAndRendering(&dword_7CD204, v17, 3, 16909060) draws the wrapped line
TextureCreationWrapper(v20, 0, -1, -1) creates the texture object used by the label rendering
resets the hover timer after a successful render: this[225] = 0.0 (byte 0x384)
